text:
Items: a toasted English muffin (2 halves, buttered) at about 140 kcal plus butter at about 40 kcal, giving about 180 kcal. Two poached or fried eggs at about 75 kcal each, giving about 150 kcal. A latte, about 300 ml of milk coffee, at about 120 kcal. A yogurt cup of about 100 g at about 100 kcal.

After eating, the plates are nearly empty, with small crumbs and a bit of yolk. The yogurt is mostly finished and the latte is finished.

Total is about 550 kcal, minus a little leftover, so roughly 540 kcal.

Mass: muffin about 90 g, eggs about 100 g, latte about 300 g, yogurt about 100 g, for about 590 g.

{"kcal": 540, "mass_g": 590}
